abstract: Human aging is a heterogeneous, multi-system process that spans molecular, tissue, and physiological decline. In this issue of Cell, Li et al. integrate clinical data, multi-omics, and organ-associated signatures to construct a multi-layer framework for quantifying biological aging across scales.
